Bone dysplasia affects long bones and jaw bones; jaw involvement is skeletal. Osteomyelitis is a separately diagnosed infection.
Chronic serous middle-ear effusion; infection or an immune-mediated mechanism is not established.
Neonatal diabetes, developmental delay and epilepsy define the syndrome; weakness and hypotonia do not establish intrinsic muscle disease.
Skull dysplasia, alopecia and hypogonadism define disease; intellectual disability/encephalocele 80-99%; ocular defects (30-99%) and dental anomalies (30-79%) omitted by cap.
Nonsyndromic X-linked intellectual disability, reported in 8/8 patients.
Neoplasm of the lip, classified here as part of the mouth and digestive system.
Corticospinal tract degeneration defines pure spastic paraplegia; weakness and amyotrophy are secondary neurologic effects, not intrinsic muscle disease.
EBV-driven clonal T-cell lymphoma with severe cytopenias; hepatic infiltration and dysfunction are common (>30%), with liver failure a characteristic presentation.
Ineffective erythropoiesis with multinucleated marrow erythroblasts and anemia; iron and bilirubin abnormalities alone do not establish other organ damage.
Parainfluenza type 3 infects respiratory epithelium, causing upper or lower airway disease.
Pulsatile protrusion of the eye is an orbital disorder; a specific vascular cause is not established by this concept.

Phosphate deficiency causes defective skeletal mineralization; renal phosphate wasting can be hormonally mediated and does not establish intrinsic kidney damage across this umbrella.
Carcinoma originates in a major salivary gland; salivary glands belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Benign neoplasm confined to the fallopian tube, a reproductive organ outside the axes; smooth-muscle histology does not imply skeletal muscle disease.
Cystic epithelial neoplasm originates in the exocrine pancreas.
Pseudomonilethrix is a hair-shaft disorder characterized by irregular apparent beading and hair fragility.
Congenital nephron deficiency with glomerular hypertrophy and common renal insufficiency; extrarenal abnormalities are rare.
Heterogeneous 5q deletion umbrella; neurodevelopmental impairment predominates across constitutional subtypes. Marrow disease belongs to the isolated del(5q) myelodysplastic subtype.
Early-onset generalized dystonia is a neurologic movement disorder; abnormal muscle contractions do not establish intrinsic muscle disease.
Disease directly affects cranial nerve VIII, the nerve serving hearing and vestibular function.
Fulminant immune-mediated hemorrhagic demyelination directly damages brain and sometimes spinal cord; typically a postinfectious form of ADEM.
Immune-mediated periarticular inflammation causes proximal pain and stiffness without primary muscle pathology; associated giant cell arteritis is a separate disease.
Congenital transposition of the great arteries with aortic coarctation directly affects cardiac and arterial anatomy.
